purpose: Per Phase29's rule, a clause may be implemented from the captured text; an equation or table the capture renders as an image must be confirmed separately and its origin recorded. This is the list of what falls on each side.

The source offers no revision later than 2024-03-21, so a 2024-05 correction notice is either not reflected there or did not alter this document; the owner is collating that separately.
items.currentBehaviour: kcscRuleSources pins edition 2024 / 2024-03-21; results carry editionPinned = true

items.subject: fy 400MPa 초과 슬래브 수축·온도철근비
items.note: Resolved. Owner-confirmed: rho = 0.0020 * 400 / fy above 400 MPa, with the clause's 0.0014 floor applying to every case, so 400 -> 0.0020, 500 -> 0.0016, 600 -> 0.0014. The ratio is on the gross concrete area b*h, not b*d.
items.confirmedValue: rho_min = max(0.0020 * 400 / fy, 0.0014) for fy > 400 MPa; 0.0020 for deformed bars at or below 400 MPa
items.correctedRecord: an earlier note in this register said substituting the 400 MPa ratio for a higher grade would understate the steel. That was backwards: the expression falls as fy rises, so the substitution would overstate the requirement. Not substituting was still right, because this clause is a minimum and silently demanding more than the code does is its own defect.

items.subject: 벽체 최소철근비·간격·두께·철근층
items.note: All prose. 4.2(3)1 is an expression, 0.0020 x 400 / fy with fy capped at 500 MPa inside the ratio, and is readable in full.

items.subject: 벽체 실용 설계법 설계축강도
items.confirmedValue: phi*Pnw = 0.55 * phi * fck * Ag * (1 - (k*lc/(32h))^2), phi = 0.65, lc = vertical length between supports, h = wall thickness
items.note2: the factor is inside the expression, so the result is already a design strength; 4.3.2(1) preconditions are tested first and a resultant outside the middle third returns NOT_CHECKED rather than a verdict
